# Gasses 2 Useful gasses that are the bread and butter of what an experienced atmos is expected to work with.
## Plasma
Gaseous phoron which is flammable but incredibly useful for industrial processes.
Burning it generates a lot of heat, producing carbon dioxide or tritium. Combustion consumes less oxygen as temperature increases, capping roughly at 1643 K.
Plasma gas also has a good specific heat capacity, making it useful for moving heat around.
## Tritium
An extremely flammable radioactive gas.
Tritium is produced when burning plasma in a burn chamber with 97% or more oxygen, saturating plasma with pluoxium, or by damaging a supermatter.
## Frezon
A highly effective coolant and valuable export gas.
Frezon has a massive specific heat making it useful as a working fluid for heat transfer. Additionally combines with nitrogen above -250 C to create nitrous oxide, absorbing energy and massively cooling the mixture. Causes genetic degradation and hallucinations in living beings that inhale it.
Frezon is created by combining 1 tritium with 50 oxygen with a nitrogen catalyst to create 51 frezon. This reaction only occurs at roughly -200 C and below. Paradoxically, as the reaction gets colder a percentage of frezon that would be produced is instead replaced with nitrogen.
## BZ
An intermediate gas used in many advanced atmospheric reactions.
Although highly sought after, BZ on its own primarily acts as a sleeping agent and hallucinogenic for slime based organisms.
BZ is created by combining 1 nitrous oxide with 2 plasma, but has several quirks that make large scale production difficult.
BZ forms faster the lower the pressure is and requires large volume to produce in bulk. BZ produces heat on formation, and only forms under 314 K. When there is more than 2 plasma per 1 nitrous oxide a portion of nitrous oxide is decomposed instead being used to make BZ.
